description: Implement Storage::S3 and Session::S3Manager with specs, and all 6 remaining model providers (Gemini, LiteLLM, LlamaCpp, Mistral, SageMaker, Writer) with specs. Update autoload module files and gemspec.
steps: 1. Create strands-rb/lib/strands/storage/s3.rb implementing Strands::Storage::S3 that includes Storage::Base. Lazy-load 'aws-sdk-s3' at runtime (begin/rescue LoadError with helpful message). Methods: initialize(bucket:, prefix:, region_name: nil), read(key), write(key, data), delete(key), exists?(key), list(prefix). Uses Aws::S3::Client for get_object/put_object/delete_object/list_objects_v2. The client is created lazily on first use.
2. Create strands-rb/spec/strands/storage/s3_spec.rb testing S3 storage with mocked Aws::S3::Client. Test all CRUD operations, list with pagination, key normalization, and LoadError handling.

3. Create strands-rb/lib/strands/session/s3_session_manager.rb implementing Strands::Session::S3Manager < Manager. Uses Storage::S3 as backend. Methods: initialize(bucket:, prefix:, session_id: nil, region_name: nil), initialize_session(agent), append_message(message, agent), sync_agent(agent), restore(agent). Stores session state as JSON under '{prefix}/sessions/{session_id}/state.json'.
4. Create strands-rb/spec/strands/session/s3_manager_spec.rb testing S3Manager with a mocked Storage::S3 instance.

5. Create strands-rb/lib/strands/models/gemini.rb - Strands::Models::Gemini using net/http to call https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/. SSE streaming via POST to /models/{model}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse&key={api_key}. Format messages in Gemini Content/Part format. Handle function calling (functionCall/functionResponse parts). Map finish reasons. Initialize with model_id:, api_key:, **params.
6. Create strands-rb/spec/strands/models/gemini_spec.rb with mocked HTTP, testing init, format_request, streaming text, tool calls, errors.

7. Create strands-rb/lib/strands/models/lite_llm.rb - Strands::Models::LiteLLM. This connects to a LiteLLM proxy server which exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. Essentially a thin wrapper that composes with OpenAI provider logic but uses a configurable base_url (default http://localhost:4000) and prefixes model_id. Initialize with model_id:, api_key: nil, base_url: 'http://localhost:4000', **params.
8. Create strands-rb/spec/strands/models/lite_llm_spec.rb testing LiteLLM provider with mocked HTTP.

9. Create strands-rb/lib/strands/models/llama_cpp.rb - Strands::Models::LlamaCpp. Connects to llama.cpp server's OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint (default http://localhost:8080). Supports grammar constraints, mirostat, tfs_z, repeat_penalty etc as extra params in request body. Initialize with model_id: 'default', base_url: 'http://localhost:8080', **params.
10. Create strands-rb/spec/strands/models/llama_cpp_spec.rb testing LlamaCpp provider with mocked HTTP.

11. Create strands-rb/lib/strands/models/mistral.rb - Strands::Models::Mistral. Uses Mistral API (https://api.mistral.ai/v1/chat/completions). SSE streaming, tool calling. Temperature validation (0.0-1.0). Initialize with model_id:, api_key: nil, base_url: 'https://api.mistral.ai', **params.
12. Create strands-rb/spec/strands/models/mistral_spec.rb testing Mistral provider with mocked HTTP.

13. Create strands-rb/lib/strands/models/sagemaker.rb - Strands::Models::SageMaker. Lazy-loads aws-sdk-sagemakerruntime. Uses invoke_endpoint_with_response_stream for streaming. Initialize with endpoint_name:, region_name: nil, model_id: nil, **params. Parses SSE chunks from the response stream.
14. Create strands-rb/spec/strands/models/sagemaker_spec.rb testing SageMaker provider with mocked AWS client.

15. Create strands-rb/lib/strands/models/writer.rb - Strands::Models::Writer. Uses Writer API (https://api.writer.com/v1/chat). SSE streaming, tool calling, context overflow detection. Initialize with model_id:, api_key: nil, base_url: 'https://api.writer.com', **params.
16. Create strands-rb/spec/strands/models/writer_spec.rb testing Writer provider with mocked HTTP.
17. Update strands-rb/lib/strands/models.rb to add autoload entries for Gemini, LiteLLM, LlamaCpp, Mistral, SageMaker, Writer.
acceptance_criteria: ruby -c for all 6 new model provider files passes
ruby -c for all new spec files passes
ruby -e "require_relative 'strands-rb/lib/strands'" loads without error (autoloads are declared)
bundle exec rspec runs and passes for mocked specs (new specs mock all external deps)
All files have frozen_string_literal comment and YARD documentation
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/harness-sdk/strands-rb && ruby -c lib/strands/models/gemini.rb && ruby -c lib/strands/models/lite_llm.rb && ruby -c lib/strands/models/llama_cpp.rb && ruby -c lib/strands/models/mistral.rb && ruby -c lib/strands/models/sagemaker.rb && ruby -c lib/strands/models/writer.rb

All verification done via ruby -c syntax checks and ruby -I lib -e require/load tests. All 8 providers, storage, and session components load correctly. Autoloads are properly declared. Mistral temperature validation confirmed working. The specs are syntactically valid and follow existing patterns but could not be executed without rspec gem.
